problems.title: Optimize Transition from Elevator to Stairs

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: try every k from 0 to n and walk the stairs floor by floor with the energy rule
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: feasibility is monotone in k, so binary search the smallest feasible k (k * e1 - (n - k - 1) * e2 > 0, or k = n); scan k upward from there, cutting a stair walk off once it reaches the best time and stopping when k * t1 + (n - k) alone reaches the best, since every stair floor costs at least 1
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(log n + n^2) worst case time/O(1) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: label propagation: give every value its own label and repeatedly set both values of each pair to the smaller label until nothing changes, then group nums by label
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: union-find keyed by value with path halving and union by size; one pass over nums assigns group indices to roots in first-seen order
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O((n + p) alpha(n + p)) time/O(n + p) space, p = pairs
